decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher sits close to the core distributed portfolio and costs little to hold, and nothing yet shows its value will not be realized, so the option stays open.

The UV spot varnishing system is a distant, high-uncertainty flagship whose market response after its German premiere is still unresolved, and with Product D already dropped it is a key growth option worth keeping.
The sheet preparation module is a cheap complementary add-on to established systems with no negative signal, so holding it costs little.
The hybrid saddle stitcher fits the core booklet-making business, has low holding costs, and its value is still uncertain, so it is kept.
The folding add-on has a documented working inline customer installation, a positive signal that justifies keeping it at minimal cost.
